empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

editor.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — write it directively: state what the agent should do. This is what an agent author reads when deciding to link it.
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete this skill? Agent links are removed too.
editor.newSkillBody:
# Untitled skill

Describe the rule the reviewing agent should apply.
editor.previewSubtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
editor.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. At review time its body is wrapped in <untrusted> delimiters and passed to the model as data, never as instructions.

versions.heading: Versions
versions.subtitle: Every saved change to the body is snapshotted. Newest first.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore this body? It is saved as a new version — history is never rewritten.

agentTab.heading: Skills
agentTab.caption: Order matters — earlier skills appear earlier in the assembled prompt. Drag to reorder.

empty.title: No skills linked
empty.body: Link a skill to add its rules to this agent's review prompt.

agentTab.noMatch: No linked skill matches that filter.
agentTab.loadError: Could not load this agent's skills.
agentTab.saveError: Could not update this agent's skills.

import.title: Add a skill
import.subtitle: Import from a .md file or a .zip archive
import.skippedNote: Only .md entries are read from an archive. Every other entry is listed and left untouched — never inflated, written to disk, or executed.
import.trustNotice: Imported skills are stored as untrusted data and arrive disabled until you vet them.
